description: HoloNET HyperNET is a P2P gaming networking layer built on top of HoloNET Client and HoloNET ORM that allows Unity and Unreal games to implement near-zero-latency peer-to-peer networking with virtually unlimited concurrent players -- eliminating the scalability ceiling of traditional cloud/dedicated server architectures. Leverages Holochain's agent-centric DHT (v0.7.0, Kitsune2/iroh QUIC) for resilient mesh networking, automatic peer discovery, and distributed state. Ideal for MMO, battle royale, and co-op experiences. Part of the OASIS Omniverse ecosystem at https://holonet.oasisomniverse.one -- Source: https://github.com/holochain-open-dev/holochain-client-csharp
releaseNotes:
## v4.6.0 - Part of the HoloNET 4.6.0 release (every HoloNET package is versioned together): https://github.com/holochain-open-dev/holochain-client-csharp/releases/tag/v4.6.0

## v4.5.0 - HyperNETSession.AgentPubKey: your own agent key, for other players to message (HyperNETTarget.Specific) and ping you.

## v4.4.0 - XML docs for every member; used by STAR's hypernet start/stop/status/config.

## v4.3.0 - HyperNET built out: zones, area of interest, unreliable + reliable messages, ping, stats, zone refresh + heartbeat, HyperNETService. Tested live with three players on Holochain 0.7.0 and 0.7.1.

## v4.2.0 - Holochain 0.7.0 + 0.7.1

- Built on HoloNET Client 4.2.0 and HoloNET ORM 4.2.0 (Holochain 0.7.1 support, ~50 client fixes, ORM entries/collections working end to end on 0.7).
- Fully tested against real Holochain 0.7.0 and 0.7.1 conductors (1,758 + 9 live/fake-conductor tests on each), line coverage ~93%.
- Requires NextGenSoftware.Logging / NextGenSoftware.WebSocket 2.0.4 (fixes below).

Full changelog: https://github.com/holochain-open-dev/holochain-client-csharp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

---

## v4.1.0 — Holochain 0.7.0 Wire Protocol Upgrade

Tracks HoloNET Client v4.1.0: full Holochain 0.7.0 wire-protocol support.
- Kitsune2/iroh (QUIC) as sole network backend (tx5/WebRTC removed).
- New paginated DumpOpTimings API on both Admin and App interfaces.
- AwaitingMemproofs app status, updated DnaStorageInfo shape.
- DesensitizedZomeCallCapGrant and CapAccessInfo typed for response-side cap grants.
- TestHarness paths configurable via HOLONET_* environment variables.

*Full Changelog:* https://github.com/holochain-open-dev/holochain-client-csharp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

---

## v4.0.0 — Holochain 0.6.2 Upgrade + OASIS Omniverse Reboot (2026)

The biggest HoloNET release since its original launch — a complete upgrade to Holochain 0.6.2 alongside the full OASIS Omniverse ecosystem relaunch at https://holonet.oasisomniverse.one

### Holochain 0.6.2 Upgrade
- Full compatibility with the new Kitsune2 networking stack and Holochain 0.6.x conductor APIs
- Upgraded GrantedFunctions wire format (string-keyed dictionary: "All"/"Listed" variants)
- Support for new conductor admin APIs: InstallApp, EnableApp, AuthorizeSigningCredentials, GenerateAgentPubKey, and more
- Clone cell support: CreateCloneCellAsync, EnableCloneCellAsync, DisableCloneCellAsync
- Countersigning support: multi-agent atomic co-signing of DHT entries
- WASM host functions: ListWasmHostFunctionsAsync, ProvideMemproofsAsync
- App peer meta info: GetAppPeerMetaInfoAsync
- Full HoloNETConfig expanded with Kitsune2Config, QUICConfig, NetworkConfig, KeystoreConfig, WASMConfig, CacheConfig

### OASIS Omniverse Reboot
- Now part of the unified OASIS Omniverse at https://oasisomniverse.one and https://holonet.oasisomniverse.one
- Upgraded to .NET 10 for maximum performance and future-proofing
- Copyright updated: NextGen Software Ltd 2019 - 2026
- Full README overhaul: every class, event, method, and property documented with code examples
- HoloNETClientAdmin fully documented: 33 admin events, 20+ admin methods
- HoloNETCollection and HoloNETObservableCollection (ORM) fully documented with XAML WPF examples
- All stale URLs updated to the new OASIS Omniverse domains
- Improved error handling, reconnect stability, and async patterns throughout
- Open source under MIT licence -- https://github.com/NextGenSoftwareUK/holochain-client-csharp
